description.value: Mr. Bro is a Korean bistro and izakaya situated in a commercial plaza on Alexandra Road in Richmond's busy dining corridor. The late-night izakaya format means it stays open well past midnight most evenings, making it a useful stop for cyclists finishing a long day on the road. Online ordering and takeout are available.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 18m; stands (7 spaces) at 43m; rack at 59m; stands at 64m; rack at 76m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an open Korean bistro and izakaya at the OSM address (#2000-8580 Alexandra Rd, Richmond) with a matching phone number. The website explicitly advertises online ordering/takeout. A notable discrepancy exists: OSM hours show lunch and dinner daily, while the website shows evening-only service (no lunch) with Wednesday closed and later closing times (1–2 AM), suggesting the website hours are more current. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Su 11:30-14:30, 17:00-22:00) conflict with the website, which shows evening-only service (no lunch), Wednesday closed, and closing times of 1–2 AM. The website hours appear more current and should be trusted.
Minor name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Mr. Bro' (with period) while the website uses 'Mr Bro' (without period).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Korean restaurant with an active website and confirmed contact details. Useful to touring cyclists as a dine-in and takeout option in Richmond.
